mainEntity.name: Ile kosztuje budowa domu w Bielsku-Białej?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ceny budowy domów w regionie śląskim zaczynają się od około 3000-3500 zł netto za metr kwadratowy w stanie surowym. Ostateczny koszt zależy od wybranego projektu, technologii oraz standardu wykończenia. Oferujemy bezpłatną, indywidualną wycenę dla każdego projektu.

mainEntity.name: Czy budujecie domy na działce klienta?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tak, realizujemy budowę domów jednorodzinnych na działkach powierzonych przez Klienta. Głównie działamy na terenie Bielska-Białej oraz w okolicznych miejscowościach (m.in. Czechowice-Dziedzice, Żywiec, Szczyrk, Cieszyn). Pomagamy też w ocenie działki pod kątem budowlanym przed rozpoczęciem prac.

mainEntity.name: Ile trwa budowa domu pod klucz?

acceptedAnswer.text: Czas budowy domu jednorodzinnego pod klucz wynosi zazwyczaj od 9 do 14 miesięcy, w zależności od warunków atmosferycznych, wielkości budynku i wybranej technologii. Stan surowy zamknięty jesteśmy w stanie osiągnąć często już po 3-4 miesiącach.

checks.title: Deliberate robots.txt groups for AI user agents
checks.fix: Every AI agent falls through to the * group. Add named groups if your policy differs by purpose (training vs search vs user fetches).

checks.title: Responses to AI agent user agents (unverified requests)
checks.standard: observation only; real agents are verified by IP or Web Bot Auth

checks.title: Content-Signal preference declared
checks.standard: Cloudflare Content Signals Policy (CC0) + IETF draft; a preference, not enforcement; Google says it does not act on it (checked 2026-09-23)
checks.fix: No Content-Signal line. Optional: add one (for example 'Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no') to each group whose policy you want to state.

checks.title: llms.txt follows the Lighthouse rules
checks.standard: community spec (llmstxt.org); Lighthouse checks it, Google Search ignores it
checks.fix: No /llms.txt. Lighthouse drops the audit from the fraction; publishing a valid one adds a counted pass. Include an H1, a '>' summary and Markdown links.

checks.title: Markdown version of the page
checks.standard: HTTP content negotiation (RFC 9110) + community practice; no consumer agent is confirmed to request it (checked 2026-09-23)
checks.fix: Optional. Offer a content-equivalent Markdown version via 'Accept: text/markdown' (with 'Vary: Accept'), a rel="alternate" type="text/markdown" link, or a .md URL.

checks.title: WebMCP tools for forms and transactions
checks.standard: W3C Community Group draft, not a standard; WebKit opposes, Mozilla neutral (checked 2026-09-23)

evidence.note: Static count of registerTool( call sites in inline and same-origin scripts, not the number of tools (a loop registers many). Use lighthouse_agentic.py webmcp-registered-tools for the real list.

checks.fix: Optional. If the site has search, booking, checkout or lead forms, register imperative tools bound to the same handlers the UI uses. Static scan only; confirm at runtime with lighthouse_agentic.py (webmcp-registered-tools).

checks.title: WebMCP registered on the current entry point
API Catalog
checks.fix: Only needed if you operate the matching service (API Catalog).

checks.title: OAuth Protected Resource Metadata
checks.fix: Only needed if you operate the matching service (OAuth Protected Resource Metadata).

checks.title: OAuth Authorization Server Metadata
checks.fix: Only needed if you operate the matching service (OAuth Authorization Server Metadata).

checks.title: Forms annotated for declarative WebMCP (static scan)
checks.fix: Lighthouse's webmcp-form-coverage audit counts only when every form has toolname or tooldescription. Annotate only forms that are safe for an agent to submit.

checks.title: ai-catalog.json (Agentic Resource Discovery)
checks.standard: Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) spec 1.0; checked by Lighthouse 13.5 ard-schema (checked 2026-09-23)
checks.fix: Only publish one if you have agent resources to list (MCP server, A2A agent, skills). Lighthouse treats its absence as not applicable.

checks.title: A2A agent card
checks.fix: Only needed if you operate the matching service (A2A agent card).

checks.title: UCP commerce profile
checks.standard: UCP (Google + Shopify open spec); depth in seo-ecommerce ucp_check.py
checks.fix: Only needed if you operate the matching service (UCP commerce profile).

audits.title: WebMCP form coverage
audits.note: Informative while any form lacks both toolname and tooldescription; counts as a binary pass once every form has one. N/A with no forms or no WebMCP support in the testing browser.

audits.title: WebMCP tools registered
audits.note: Always informative. Lists declarative and imperative tools seen during the page load. Never changes the fraction.

audits.title: WebMCP schemas are valid
audits.note: Scores 0 on errors (missing tool name or description, a required parameter without a name) and 0.5 on warnings, so both count as a failure. N/A when no tools and no issues exist.

audits.title: Cumulative Layout Shift
audits.note: Numeric lab CLS. Passes at score 0.9 or higher (about CLS 0.1 or less).

audits.title: llms.txt follows recommendations
audits.note: Binary. /llms.txt needs an H1, one Markdown link, and 50+ characters. A 4xx makes it N/A; a 5xx or fetch error fails it.

audits.title: `ai-catalog.json` schema is valid
audits.note: Validates ai-catalog.json (Agentic Resource Discovery). N/A unless a catalog is signalled or /.well-known/ai-catalog.json returns 200.

paths.how: Binary. Fails when any of 33 axe rules fails (names and labels, ARIA validity, tree structure, tabindex, autocomplete). Fix the listed rules.

Serve /llms.txt with an H1, a summary, and Markdown links.
